headline: Compiler & Systems Engineer
summary: Compiler-focused engineer working close to the metal: LLVM IR optimization passes, toolchain performance, and language design, applied to real high-performance workloads.

lines: Coursework: Advanced Topics in High Performance Computing, Distributed Systems and Middleware, Data Security in Machine Learning, Network Design and Security
Coursework: Compiler Design and Development, AI and Machine Learning in High Performance Computing, Network Architecture and Security, Theory of Computing, Software Design Practices

experience.title: Research Assistant — Compiler Optimization
bullets: Built OMPRTF (OpenMP RunTime Fabric) for Iowa State's SWAPP lab, a custom OpenMP runtime and dynamic-analysis pipeline that applies aggressive, conditional optimizations to GPU-offload programs by lowering them to LLVM IR.
Wrote an LLVM optimization pass that breaks opaque OpenMP runtime calls into discrete IR instructions, pruning redundant host-GPU data movement without destabilizing kernels.

experience.title: Firmware Engineer Intern
bullets: Contributed to compiler-modernization planning for the department, advocating for LLVM/Clang and reasoning through migration trade-offs and risks.
Worked across large legacy codebases and hypervisor architecture, and gained exposure to IBM Quantum and Cloud.

projects.name: Omni HTTP Router
bullets: Built a Rust HTTP router that resolves middleware at compile time into fully static stacks, routing a request in under 30 instructions on SIMD-enabled x86.
Wrote a compiler that lowers a routing DSL to native object files and generates matching Terraform and binaries for easy, fast cloud deployment.

projects.name: Minnesotan Programming Language
bullets: Designed a Turing-complete esoteric language and built an end-to-end compiler with Flex/Bison that emits LLVM IR, compiling to native executables.
Implemented a custom lexer and parser that transform the language's colloquial syntax into an AST before LLVM IR emission.
